title: NBI arrests individual posing as Mandaue lawmaker's representative

blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The National Bureau of Investigation arrested a man accused of posing as a representative of a congressional office and other government offices to collect money from individuals seeking government assistance. The suspect was identified as Christian de Asis, who allegedly claimed to have connections with the Office of Mandaue City Rep. Emmarie “Lolypop” Ouano-Dizon to facilitate applications for medical, educational, and other forms of government assistance. NBI-Cebu District Office (NBI-CEBDO) head agent Arnel Pura, in a press conference on Tuesday, October 20, said that De Asis was arrested on Oct. 14, 2026, following complaints referred by Ouano-Dizon’s […]...
